brief: Council brief 023 (D136 #1); SYNTHESIS_023.md section 6.1 EXP-11 KAPPA-FWD, rank #1
label: OBSERVED (completion series) + DERIVED (ratio, slope, median, bound, excess, verdict)
statement: Measurement audit of an observed series. The per-system lower->upper transition ratio kappa is tested for forward-usability (leg (a) stationarity; leg (b) temporal hold-out on the 7 post-2020 cells with the pre-2021 kappa) and is NOT asserted to cause anything. No causal claim; no direction claim. D63 remains UNABLE as to cause. EXP-6 is not re-scored (different estimand). No threshold, bar, split rule, pairing rule or verdict string was changed after results; no re-fit; one estimand. VERDICT: WINDOW-ONLY.

verdict.rule: FORWARD-USABLE iff PHL and KOR and KHM are each kappa-STABLE AND the hold-out is BOUND-HOLDS (>=6 of 7); otherwise WINDOW-ONLY. UNDETERMINED only on a mechanical block.
verdict.leg_a_stationarity: FAIL (not all of PHL/KOR/KHM are kappa-STABLE)
verdict.falsifier_arms: >=2 hold-out violations (V=4); the PHL-slope arm did NOT fire (PHL slope -0.000704/yr)
verdict.branch_fired: WINDOW-ONLY -> kappa may NOT enter V16-REPAIR as a forward constraint; it may enter only as a declared within-window trajectory input (never extrapolated) or not at all; every 2025+ statement inherits the limit and must be labelled scenario/trajectory.
verdict.no_single_global_kappa: D133: a single kappa overstates KHM by 0.354; no global kappa is computed or used
verdict.chn_status: reported, NOT a forward constraint (D133 non-stationary); 0 post-2020 cells; excluded from the conjunction, the 7-cell denominator and the falsifier
